name: The Tarnished Archaeologist
noteEs: Archaeologist real, profesor universitario que aplica metodología académica al lore de Elden Ring. Lee las inscripciones del juego como artefactos arqueológicos y conecta cada simbolismo con mitología real (mesopotámica, gnóstica, hindú). Para quien busca lore con backing histórico-cultural.
noteEn: An actual archaeologist and university professor who applies academic methodology to Elden Ring lore. Reads the game's inscriptions as archaeological artifacts and connects each symbol to real-world mythology (Mesopotamian, Gnostic, Hindu). For viewers who want lore with historical-cultural backing.
highlightsEs: Videos largos (30-60 min) con metodología académica visible
Conexiones con mitologías reales: Marika como reflejo de diosas mediterráneas, los Outer Gods en clave gnóstica
Cobertura profunda de Shadow of the Erdtree con teorías sobre Miquella y Radahn
Tono profesoral pero accesible — no requiere background académico
Sin clickbait; títulos descriptivos que respetan al viewer
highlightsEn: Long-form videos (30-60 min) with visible academic methodology
Connections to real mythologies: Marika as a reflection of Mediterranean goddesses, the Outer Gods in Gnostic terms
Deep Shadow of the Erdtree coverage with theories on Miquella and Radahn
Professorial but accessible tone — no academic background required
No clickbait; descriptive titles that respect the viewer
